_doc: Documentation artifact for ops/rc_config.json. NOT loaded by config_validator.py at runtime — validation logic is hardcoded in core/config_validator.py. See CONFIG_AUTHORITY.md for the rationale.

_field_notes.heartbeat_interval_s: Read by main.py when constructing DevRuntime. Default 1.0s if absent. Not present in the live rc_config.json today — main.py falls back to hardcoded default.
_field_notes.command_poll_interval_s: Read by main.py when constructing DevRuntime. Default 0.5s if absent. Not present in live rc_config.json today.
_field_notes.heartbeat_timeout: max_heartbeat_age_seconds (here) is read directly by rc_supervisor.py (FROZEN). Validator covers the non-frozen read path; the frozen read is self-documenting.
_field_notes.app_cmd: Must be a list with at least one element. First element is the Python executable.
